Karnataka State Pharmacy Council

The Karnataka State Pharmacy Council is a statutory body constituted under an Act of Indian parliament called Pharmacy Act 1948 (Act No 8 of 1948), www.pci.nic.in - Rules & Regulation.

The main objective of Karnataka State Pharmacy Council is to regulate the professional practice to ensure only qualified registered Pharmacist would enter the profession to provide service to the patient.

KPCRPWT Death Claim application form

 Notification!!!

Dear Applicant/Pharmacist,

1) User Manual for Authentication and HP-ID Training Module https://rpp.kspcdic.com/pdf/HP ID Creation User Manual SPC.pdf

2) Health Professional Registry (HPR): In case of any grievances, kindly follow the following steps as under: Go to https://digipharmed.pci.gov.in/#/login-issue and select IT in the Department and Submit your issues under "HPR/Pharmacists Registration or Profile Issues".

3) Fresh Registration - Please note that KSPC is receiving a high volume of Fresh applications from February 2026. There is currently a delay of 30 working days in the verification process. All submissions are processed on a first-come, first-served basis. We appreciate your patience and cooperation. You may track your application status at https://kspcdic.com/track_application/search

4) Lending of KSPC Registration Certificate is an offence.

5) You are hereby informed to verify and update your residential/permanent address in Karnataka. Login to your KSPC account via https://rpp.kspcdic.com/kspce_user and update the same.

6) Karnataka State Pharmacy Council has obtained Goods and Services Tax (GST) registration number 29AAIFK4865B1Z7 effective from 4th October 2024. GST at the rate of 18% will be applied to all our service bills.

7) The submission of Application forms & documents, and surrendering of Original Certificates for E-Certificate should be sent only through speed post or courier to this office.
